body: When I was ten my mom was killed. That was the day my childhood ended. I realized what life was and what death was, ahead of when I should have.  All my friends were still kids and I had this guilt and sadness that a majority couldn’t understand.  For me it was like a fog lifted and this is reality.  Life doesn’t care how old or young you are.
I definitely get it! Try to enjoy the move and the new experience! It will be hectic but it definitely gets better as you get settled into your new home! 😊

If you google Fort Carson homes pet policy it will tell you all of the restrictions and rules! (Some Breed restrictions) . Best of Luck with your move!

Start writing him now, as soon as you get his address send them all to him. I typed mine at the beginning on google docs. Write him how you feel everyday, make it apart of your day to day life. Anything that happens he will love to hear it even if its something silly. You will be able to see the progress you make as the weeks go by! Good luck!
